name: msa_sparse_decode_hd128_blk128
description: MiniMax sparse decode attention with the flashinfer.msa_ops.msa_sparse_decode_attention contract (flashinfer PR #4355): batch_size requests of seqlen_q right-aligned query tokens each (1 for decode, 4/8/16 for speculative and MTP decode), every token attending only the 128-token KV blocks selected for its kv head in q2k_indices, causal, GQA, head_dim 128, softmax_scale 1/sqrt(128). K/V are flat varlen (cu_seqlens_k) or paged in 128-token pages (page_table, seqused_k); q is bf16/fp16 and K/V share its dtype or are fp8 E4M3 with a bf16 q. Output is [batch_size * seqlen_q, num_qo_heads, head_dim] in q's dtype; a token with an empty selection gets zeros. Workloads are the PR benchmark's ten decode rows.

head_dim.description: Query, key and value head dimension.

block_size.description: Tokens per selectable KV block and per KV page.

topk.description: Selected KV blocks per (kv head, query token); -1 padded.

total_k.description: Flat rows: batch_size * seqlen_kv tokens; 0 on paged rows.

num_pages.description: Paged rows: total 128-token pages; 0 on flat rows.

max_pages.description: Paged rows: page_table columns (ceil(seqlen_kv / 128)); 0 on flat rows.

kv_dtype.description: q_dtype, or 'float8_e4m3fn' with a bfloat16 q (no scales).

seed.description: flashinfer PR #4355's manifest seed for this row (q/k/v generator; q2k_indices use seed + 101).

constraints: q2k_indices entries are ascending within a row, -1 padded, and < ceil(kv_len / block_size)
kv_layout == 'flat' implies page_table and seqused_k are None; kv_layout == 'paged' implies cu_seqlens_k is None
kv_dtype == q_dtype, or kv_dtype == float8_e4m3fn and q_dtype == bfloat16

q.description: Queries in q_dtype (bfloat16 or float16), contiguous. Request b owns rows b*seqlen_q:(b+1)*seqlen_q, right-aligned to the end of its KV.

k.description: Keys in kv_dtype. Flat rows: [total_k, num_kv_heads, head_dim] indexed by cu_seqlens_k; paged rows: [num_pages, num_kv_heads, block_size, head_dim] (128-token pages) indexed by page_table.

v.description: Values in kv_dtype. Flat rows: [total_k, num_kv_heads, head_dim] indexed by cu_seqlens_k; paged rows: [num_pages, num_kv_heads, block_size, head_dim] (128-token pages) indexed by page_table.

q2k_indices.description: Per (kv head, query token) ascending batch-local ids of the selected 128-token KV blocks, -1 padded.

cu_seqlens_k.description: Cumulative KV lengths (flat rows); None on paged rows.

page_table.description: Batch-local block id -> page (paged rows); None on flat rows.

seqused_k.description: Valid KV tokens per sequence (paged rows); None on flat rows.

seqlen_q.description: Query tokens per request, uniform across the batch.

output.description: Attention output in q's dtype; a new tensor, inputs are not modified.

reference:
import torch

BLOCK_SIZE = 128


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    q2k_indices: torch.Tensor,
    cu_seqlens_k,
    page_table,
    seqused_k,
    seqlen_q: int,
    softmax_scale: float,
):
    """
    MiniMax sparse decode attention (flashinfer.msa_ops.
    msa_sparse_decode_attention semantics) in fp32, one request at a time:

    • q is [batch_size * seqlen_q, Hq, D]; request b owns query tokens
      b*seqlen_q:(b+1)*seqlen_q, right-aligned so token i sits at KV position
      kv_len - seqlen_q + i. Its KV tokens are either
      cu_seqlens_k[b]:cu_seqlens_k[b+1] of the flat k/v [total_k, Hkv, D]
      (page_table is None) or the first seqused_k[b] tokens of the 128-token
      pages page_table[b, :] of the paged k/v [num_pages, Hkv, 128, D].
    • query head h reads kv head h // (Hq // Hkv); token i may attend only the
      tokens of the 128-token KV blocks listed in
      q2k_indices[kv_head, b*seqlen_q + i] (batch-local block ids, -1 padded)
      at positions <= kv_len - seqlen_q + i (causal).
    • softmax over the attended tokens with softmax_scale; a token whose
      selection is empty gets zeros. fp8 K/V dequantize by plain cast.
    • output [batch_size * seqlen_q, Hq, D] in q's dtype.
    """

    num_qo_heads, head_dim = q.shape[1], q.shape[2]
    num_kv_heads = k.shape[1]
    group = num_qo_heads // num_kv_heads
    device = q.device
    q_len = int(seqlen_q)
    if page_table is None:
        cu_k = cu_seqlens_k.tolist()
        kv_lens = [cu_k[b + 1] - cu_k[b] for b in range(len(cu_k) - 1)]
    else:
        kv_lens = seqused_k.tolist()

    out = torch.zeros(q.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    for b, kv_len in enumerate(kv_lens):
        q_start, q_end = b * q_len, (b + 1) * q_len
        if page_table is None:
            kb = k[cu_k[b] : cu_k[b + 1]].float()
            vb = v[cu_k[b] : cu_k[b + 1]].float()
        else:
            pages = page_table[b, : (kv_len + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE].long()
            kb = k[pages].float().permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, head_dim)[:kv_len]
            vb = v[pages].float().permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, head_dim)[:kv_len]
        qb = q[q_start:q_end].float().view(q_len, num_kv_heads, group, head_dim)
        selected = q2k_indices[:, q_start:q_end]  # [Hkv, q_len, topk]
        positions = torch.arange(kv_len, device=device)
        allowed = (
            (positions // BLOCK_SIZE).view(1, 1, -1, 1) == selected.unsqueeze(2)
        ).any(-1)  # [Hkv, q_len, kv_len]
        q_pos = kv_len - q_len + torch.arange(q_len, device=device)
        allowed &= positions.view(1, 1, -1) <= q_pos.view(1, -1, 1)
        allowed = allowed.unsqueeze(2)  # [Hkv, q_len, 1, kv_len]
        logits = torch.einsum("qhgd,khd->hqgk", qb, kb) * float(softmax_scale)
        probs = torch.softmax(logits.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf")), dim=-1)
        probs = torch.where(allowed.any(-1, keepdim=True), probs, 0.0)
        ob = torch.einsum("hqgk,khd->qhgd", probs, vb)
        out[q_start:q_end] = ob.reshape(q_len, num_qo_heads, head_dim)
    return out.to(q.dtype)
